note: Outside on the three criteria that matter commercially. He is a quality control inspector on a filter production line working ten-hour shifts, and simultaneously a self-funding student — not a business owner, physician or equivalent. Income fails as hard as it can fail in this corpus: roughly $300 of monthly surplus, a single credit card with a $300 total limit, $2,100 of tuition due in August, and a third-party lender that declined him twice during the call. And he is not good wanting great — he had not trained at all for three years, realised it live on the call, and is three weeks into a comeback he describes as coming out of hibernation. Two criteria do hold, and they matter for how this is read: health is genuinely the neglected area rather than a crisis, and he is emphatically not the gym-averse exclusion — he trained consistently for two years, warmed up and stretched every session while friends mocked him for it, hikes, and used to boulder every weekend. He is the mirror image of the Hariharan call in this same batch: identical enthusiasm and coachability, opposite balance sheet. The useful finding is not that he was outside the ICP, it is that the qualification that would have established it took one question about his credit limit and was asked at minute forty-one, after a full presentation.
